runtime: HIA policy plus HIA-emitted static Linux adapter; no libc, SQLite, Rust, or Python runtime
encoding: All integer fields are unsigned little-endian u64 unless explicitly stated otherwise. Digests are exact 32 bytes.

fields: explicit observer write FD or UINT64_MAX (8)
explicit gate read FD or UINT64_MAX (8)
bootstrap.capability_transfer: The input directory FD must be >=3. Native openat(dirfd, dot, O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC) creates its private directory description, then closes its inherited input descriptor. The launcher retains no runtime service role.
bootstrap.optional_gate: Both gate FDs must be explicitly supplied, distinct, >=3, and distinct from the directory FD. Both UINT64_MAX disables the gate. Ambient FD numbers never activate it.

operations.1: commit: followed by exactly payload byte count bytes
operations.2: get: payload count zero; validate current immutable transaction then stream exact payload
operations.3: close: payload count zero; release owned descriptors and exit

kinds.0: owner opened and complete retained chain verified
kinds.1: new HEAD and its directory successfully synchronized
kinds.2: GET header followed by exact payload bytes

response.close: Successful close produces process exit 0, without another response.

namespace.lock: owner.lock, flock LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB, held until close/exit
namespace.fresh: Only dot, dotdot, and the owner-created lock may exist. No SQLite compatibility or implicit import.
namespace.existing: FORMAT and HEAD must exist and validate. Referenced transactions must be regular files with one hardlink, exact UID/mode/length and a valid complete hash chain. Unreferenced own temporary/next-transaction files are never promoted to committed state.
namespace.scope: Exclusive directory capability and cooperating owner lock; hostile same-UID mutation, filesystem rollback, network filesystem semantics, and privileged mount replacement are not qualified.
namespace.required_data_file_open: FORMAT, HEAD, and referenced transaction files use O_RDONLY|O_NONBLOCK|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC (657408). fstat type/UID/mode/link checks precede any data read; transaction length bounds precede header reading, and exact header-derived size is rechecked afterward.
namespace.unreferenced_remnants: Allowed-name objects not referenced by HEAD are not type-qualified or read during recovery and never establish committed state. A subsequent commit may remove only its exact unreferenced successor/temp names.

head_and_transaction_header.transaction_file: exact header then exact payload; filename sequence must match; no trailing bytes
head_and_transaction_header.genesis: sequence=0, payload length=0, previous digest all zero; no transaction file

hashes.algorithm: SHA-256, canonical HIA arena helper included exactly once
hashes.start: SHA256(ASCII HIAHASH1 || context32 || sequence_u64le || payload_length_u64le || previous_digest32)
hashes.chunk: Starting from start, for each fixed 32768-byte chunk (last may be smaller), SHA256(ASCII HIAHASH2 || prior_hash32 || chunk_length_u64le || exact_chunk). Empty payload retains start.
hashes.qualification: Storage-domain chunk chain; not a claim that the commit digest is plain SHA256(payload) or a protocol state root.

commit: remove only next unreferenced transaction/temp names
write header and payload with partial-result cursor
publish private state and durable response
recovery: Read exact HEAD, verify current transaction and every predecessor payload/digest/sequence/context back to independently computed genesis. Repeated recovery does not advance HEAD. Missing/corrupt referenced objects reject.

fields: private committed sequence (not proof of delivered acknowledgement)

exit_codes.70: I/O outside the HEAD publication uncertainty interval; does not imply rollback

failure.retry: EINTR for read/write/pread/pwrite/fsync/fstat/getdents preserves the exact command. Positive partial IO advances the pointer, remaining count and positioned offset. close EINTR is not retried. EAGAIN is a terminal refusal for this blocking-file owner.
failure.commit_uncertainty: Any failure from the HEAD rename attempt until successful directory fsync is UNKNOWN_COMMIT. No live continuation or fabricated rollback receipt.
failure.missing_commit_receipt: A missing or incomplete COMMIT response requires reopen and HEAD comparison regardless of exit code. The HEAD may already be durably committed when the response write fails. Never retry unconditionally based on exit 70.

fields: private committed sequence (u64le; not proof of delivered acknowledgement)
observer.resume: one exact byte 0x01 on the explicitly supplied gate input

tags.14: new HEAD file fsync returned success
tags.15: HEAD rename returned success; directory not yet synced

observer.authority: An explicit diagnostic pause capability, not a request deadline, peer permission, or physical power-loss simulator.

remaining: typed Node reducers and runtime integration
private identity signing and secret ownership
qualification_entry: The complete process/filesystem qualification is the mandatory independent hia.tools.qualify_storage CLI; native unit tests cover buffer shapes and emitted open-command contracts without repeating that complete gate.
